record_type_quote: We conducted an external close replication of the original lab study.

targets.title: Interruptibility of software developers and its prediction using psycho-physiological sensors.
targets.evidence_quote:
In this paper, we report on what is, to the best of our knowledge, the first external and
close replication of the original lab study (Züger and Fritz 2015).
targets.outcome_quote:
The original results did not generalize to our more varied setting (e.g.,
participant profile). We recommend only conceptually replicating the original study.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Overall abstract conclusion says the original results did not generalize. Main predictive models failed to exceed baseline. Authors discuss validity threats but do not deem this attempt incapable of adjudication; their substantive verdict is failure.

reasoning: Verified title, authors, DOI and complete 33-page paper including references. Ten new participants replicate only the original lab experiment; subsequent field papers and background studies are not targets. Overall verdict takes precedence over individual subsidiary correlations that agreed.
